audience: event organizers who check registrations, sessions and sponsors in Swoogo

useCases.title: Check upcoming events and their dates
useCases.text: List the events in the account with dates, timezone and status. Open one event to read its settings and registration URL.

useCases.title: Count confirmed registrants
useCases.text: List the registrants of one event, filtered by registration status such as confirmed. Open one registrant to read the details.

useCases.title: Build the agenda from sessions and tracks
useCases.text: List the sessions, tracks and speakers of one event. Open a session to read its title, times and location.

useCases.title: Review sponsors and payments
useCases.text: List the sponsors of one event, then list the payment transactions of the same event.

useCases.title: Check who attended which session
useCases.text: List the session attendance records of one event to see which registrant attended which session.
